incidents.titre: Connection pool exhaustion after a configuration change
symptomes: error rate spike shortly after a deployment
incidents.cause_racine: A deployment reduced db.max_pool_size, leaving the pool undersized for nominal load.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back the deployment and restored the pool size to its previous value. Added an alert on pool utilisation.

incidents.titre: Latency spike on the external payment processor (Stripe)
symptomes: Stripe call latency above the reference p95
error rate increase correlated with external latency
incidents.cause_racine: Transient degradation on the external provider's side, with no internal change.
incidents.resolution: Deployed a circuit breaker with backoff retries on processor calls; fail over to a secondary processor when available.

incidents.titre: Webhook signature verification broken by HTTP header normalisation
symptomes: signature header missing on the application side
silent HTTP 401 rejection on inbound callbacks
no immediate alert, backlog accumulates gradually
case-sensitive header lookup after an SDK migration
incidents.cause_racine: The new verification code reads the HTTP header with exact case, while the gateway/CDN normalises all headers to lowercase: verification fails systematically after the deployment.
incidents.resolution: Switched to a case-insensitive header lookup (header.get() instead of an exact dict access) and replayed the pending events from the provider's retry queue.

symptomes: timeouts on PayPal API calls, delayed webhook delivery
orders stuck awaiting confirmation during the provider incident
failure rate increase correlated with PayPal availability
incidents.cause_racine: Transient degradation on the external payment provider's side (PayPal), with no internal change deployed.
incidents.resolution: Waited for the provider-side resolution, temporarily routed new critical transactions to a secondary PSP, tracked via the public status page.
